Published_claim: LEO dopaminergic organoids showed higher TH expression
My_reproduction: TH had positive log2FC in all 4 matched LEO-vs-Ground contrasts
Main_caveat: Consistent direction does not equal subgroup-level statistical significance

Published_claim: LEO dopaminergic organoids showed higher DDC expression
My_reproduction: DDC had positive log2FC in all 4 matched LEO-vs-Ground contrasts
Main_caveat: Statistical support was strong but not uniform across all four subgroup contrasts

Published_claim: Early progenitor markers VIM, SOX2 and PAX6 were lower in LEO
My_reproduction: VIM, SOX2 and PAX6 had negative log2FC in all 4 matched contrasts
Main_caveat: Transcript changes do not by themselves establish neuronal maturation

Published_claim: Cell-cycle-associated markers CCND1, CDKN1A and GADD45A were lower in LEO
My_reproduction: CCND1, CDKN1A and GADD45A had negative log2FC in all 4 matched contrasts
Main_caveat: These genes may also reflect cell-cycle or stress-related state changes

Published_claim: The combined transcriptional pattern was interpreted as accelerated maturation in LEO
My_reproduction: Selected maturation-associated markers increased while selected progenitor/cell-cycle-associated markers decreased
Statistical_support: Statistical support varies by marker and subgroup
Main_caveat: This reproduction tested a predefined marker panel, not the full transcriptome-wide maturation signature

Published_claim: The study was not powered to detect PD-specific disease differences
My_reproduction: OSD-871 contains one Control donor/cell line and one PD donor/cell line, so disease status is confounded with donor/cell line
Main_caveat: PD-vs-Control differences cannot be generalized independently of donor/cell-line effects
